name: nav-buttons
description: Thin renderer over ranch/nav-buttons-registry.json. Each blueprint/mechanism declares nav_buttons[]; installer aggregates. v2.3.0 ADDITIVE: adds invoke_command action type for arbitrary Obsidian command dispatch; adds top arrow-row prev/next-day daily-nav (skip-to-nearest-existing with grey-out) when daily blueprint installed (reads .obsidian/daily-notes.json at runtime). Adaptive multi-row layout + hover styling unchanged from v2.0.0.; v2.4.0: additive 'journal' ICONS entry for journal blueprint; v2.5.0: date-aware runTemplaterTemplate dispatcher (active-file basename → date); v2.5.1 PATCH ADDITIVE: ICONS entries 'trips' (plane) + 'trip' (location pin) for trips@0.1.0 blueprint; v2.5.2 PATCH ADDITIVE: ICONS entry 'finance' (wallet) for finance@0.1.0 blueprint; v2.5.3 PATCH ADDITIVE: ICONS entry 'people' (Lucide users glyph) for people@0.1.0 blueprint; v2.6.0 MINOR ADDITIVE: invoke_command action gains optional 'args' object (string→string map) — literal passthrough through install.js validateAndResolve + dispatched as second arg to app.commands.executeCommandById; fallback path writes args to <vault>/.scratch/nav-button-pending-args.json since Obsidian's executeCommandById doesn't natively accept args today, so the args land BOTH places (best-effort dual-write); v2.6.1 PATCH ADDITIVE: ICONS entry 'scratch' (Lucide pencil-into-note glyph) for scratch@0.2.1 nav-button; v2.6.2 PATCH ADDITIVE: ICONS entry 'briefcase' (Lucide briefcase glyph) for cowork@0.6.0 nav-button. v2.7.0 MINOR (v0.47.0): hardcoded ICONS map deleted from space-nav-buttons.js; consumer of NEW icons@0.1.0 mechanism. SVG vocabulary unchanged — Tier 1 vendored map in icons.js is byte-for-byte the same as the deleted ICONS const. v0.120.3 wired new-note create paths to read mode via customJS.OpenHelpers. v2.7.3 PATCH (v0.120.3 review): the createFromTemplate + runTemplaterTemplate new-note tails now capture the opened leaf and call customJS.OpenHelpers?.forceLeafPreview?.(leaf) (captured handle avoids flipping the wrong note); invoke_command keeps the deferred forceActiveLeafPreview (async open, no handle). All call sites optional-chained for cold-load safety. Read-mode forcing is scoped to NEW notes only (existing-file fast paths unchanged). v2.9.0 MINOR (nav launcher): the always-visible multi-row button grid is replaced by a single collapsed 'Go to…' pill merged into the daily-arrow row (one chrome line); tapping it opens a native Obsidian Menu (bottom-sheet on mobile, dropdown on desktop) built from the same registry entries via _buildMenu, dispatching through the unchanged _dispatchAction. Falls back to an inline accordion when the Menu constructor is unobtainable (_getMenuCtor). Fixes mobile label truncation + reclaims ~3 rows of vertical chrome on every note. Registry/action schema/consumer declarations unchanged. v2.10.0 MINOR (nav launcher polish): the daily quick-nav is split out of the menu into an always-present 'Daily' pill beside 'Go to…' (jumps to today via the daily entry's own action, _splitDaily); the native-Menu reveal is replaced by a custom launcher OVERLAY appended to document.body (full-width bottom sheet on mobile via app.isMobile, anchored dropdown on desktop) so it is never clipped and labels never truncate — _getMenuCtor/_buildMenu removed, _openLauncher/_buildOverlayRow/_renderDailyButton/_stylePill added; backdrop-tap/Escape/re-tap dismiss. Still dispatches through the unchanged _dispatchAction; registry/action schema/consumer declarations unchanged. v2.11.0 MINOR (chrome two-row layout): the prev/next-day arrows now occupy their own top row (space-between); the Daily + Go to… pills move to a second row and split it evenly (each flex:1); the desktop launcher dropdown widened to min 300px. Pure layout change — render helpers return their element so render() sets the flex; overlay/dispatch/registry unchanged. v2.12.0 MINOR (3-column grid): the pills render in a fixed 3-column CSS grid — Daily | To-Do | Scratch / Projects | Meetings | Go to… — where the final cell is the launcher menu holding every OTHER blueprint. Pins are chosen by _partitionEntries via a fixed _source order (daily,to-do,scratch,project,meetings), first-per-source; absent pins drop their cell (grid reflows). _splitDaily→_partitionEntries, _renderDailyButton→_renderEntryButton (generic, ellipsised label). Overlay/dispatch/registry/action schema unchanged.
